## LilyPond Snippet

```lilypond
\version "2.24.0"

\header {
  title = "Five Minor Motif Versions"
  subtitle = "Eighth-note motifs with left-hand chords"
}

global = { \time 4/4 }

% ---- 1. A Natural Minor ----
melodyANat = \relative c' {
  \key a \minor
  \clef treble
  c8 e g a g e d c |
  b4 a2.\fermata \bar "||"
}

chordsANat = \relative c {
  \key a \minor
  \clef bass
  <a c e>1 |
  <a c e>1\fermata \bar "||"
}

% ---- 2. A Harmonic Minor ----
melodyAHarm = \relative c' {
  \key a \minor
  c8 e gis a gis e d c |
  b4 a2.\fermata \bar "||"
}

chordsAHarm = \relative c {
  \key a \minor
  <a c e>2 <e gis b>2 |
  <a c e>1\fermata \bar "||"
}

% ---- 3. A Melodic Minor ----
melodyAMel = \relative c' {
  \key a \minor
  c8 e fis gis a g e d |
  c8 b a2.\fermata \bar "||"
}

chordsAMel = \relative c {
  \key a \minor
  <a c e>2 <d fis a>2 |
  <a c e>1\fermata \bar "||"
}

% ---- 4. C Natural Minor ----
melodyCNat = \relative c' {
  \key c \minor
  c8 ees g aes g ees d c |
  bes4 c2.\fermata \bar "||"
}

chordsCNat = \relative c {
  \key c \minor
  <c ees g>1 |
  <c ees g>1\fermata \bar "||"
}

% ---- 5a. C Harmonic Minor ----
melodyCHarm = \relative c' {
  \key c \minor
  c8 ees g aes g ees d c |
  b4 c2.\fermata \bar "||"
}

chordsCHarm = \relative c {
  \key c \minor
  <c ees g>2 <g b d>2 |
  <c ees g>1\fermata \bar "||"
}

% ---- 5b. C Melodic Minor ----
melodyCMel = \relative c' {
  \key c \minor
  c8 ees g a b c bes aes |
  g8 f ees d c2\fermata \bar "||"
}

chordsCMel = \relative c {
  \key c \minor
  <c ees g>2 <f a c>4 <g b d>4 |
  <c, ees g>1\fermata \bar "||"
}

% ---- Score ----
\score {
  <<
    \new PianoStaff <<
      \new Staff = "right" {
        \global
        \melodyANat
        \melodyAHarm
        \melodyAMel
        \melodyCNat
        \melodyCHarm
        \melodyCMel
      }
      \new Staff = "left" {
        \global
        \chordsANat
        \chordsAHarm
        \chordsAMel
        \chordsCNat
        \chordsCHarm
        \chordsCMel
      }
    >>
  >>
  \layout { }
  \midi { \tempo 4 = 90 }
}
```

A few notes on using this: paste the whole block into a `.ly` file and compile with LilyPond 2.24 or later. The `\midi` block at the bottom means LilyPond will also generate a MIDI file you can play back directly, so you get both the sheet music and an audio preview in one pass. The fermatas on the final notes of each version give you a moment to hear the tonic settle before the next version begins.

If any of the note counts feel off when you play through them, let me know which version and I'll adjust the rhythms or bar lines.
